front_content.text:
原句：传统家风文化在当代社会治理中仍具有重要价值，并持续影响青年一代的行为选择。

任务：先汉译英，再选出语义完整且语体自然的译文。

back_content.text: Traditional family values still carry significant importance in contemporary social governance and continue to influence the behavioral choices of younger generations.
back_content.explanation: 该句需要并列呈现“现实价值”与“持续影响”两层信息，避免只保留其中一层。

analysis_content.text:
① 识别信号：原句含“仍具有……并持续影响……”，是并列双重判断。

② 核心规律：历史文化论述常见“价值判断 + 现实影响”双轴结构，英译应并列保留两个谓语。

③ 验证：正确译文中 carry significant importance 与 continue to influence 分别对应两条信息链，逻辑完整。
tips: 文化类句子要同时保“价值层”和“影响层”。
并列双谓语是处理双轴信息的高效方案。

options.text: Traditional family values still carry significant importance in contemporary social governance and continue to influence the behavioral choices of younger generations.
Traditional family values still carry significant importance in contemporary social governance, which influences younger generations' behavioral choices continuously.
Traditional family values are important in contemporary social governance and the younger generations are continuously influenced behaviors.
Traditional family values still have importance and continue influencing young generation behavior choices in governance society contemporary.

front_content.text:
原句：这一文化传统代代相传，成为民族认同的重要纽带。

先做汉译英，再补全固定搭配：
This cultural tradition has been passed down from generation to generation, becoming an important {{blank}} of national identity.

back_content.text: This cultural tradition has been passed down from generation to generation, becoming an important bond of national identity.
back_content.explanation: 纽带在文化语境中常用 bond 表达，和 national identity 搭配自然。

analysis_content.text:
① 识别信号：中文“成为……纽带”对应的是抽象关系名词。

② 核心规律：文化身份语境里，bond of identity 比 link with identity 更凝练且更常见。

③ 验证：填入 bond 后，becoming an important bond of national identity 语义完整，语体统一。
tips: 抽象关系词要选语域稳定的高频搭配。
national identity 常与 bond/cohesion 搭配出现。

front_content.text:
原句：中华优秀传统文化塑造了民族精神，也为当代社会治理提供了价值资源。

任务：先汉译英，再检查是否并列表达“精神塑造 + 治理支撑”。

back_content.text: Fine traditional Chinese culture has shaped the national spirit and also provided value resources for contemporary social governance.
back_content.explanation: 并列句应在同一主语下并列呈现双重作用。

analysis_content.text:
① 识别信号：句中“也为……”提示第二并列结果。

② 核心规律：文化论述句可用 has shaped ... and also provided ... 承接“价值建构+现实功能”双层逻辑。

③ 验证与纠偏：译文主语统一、谓语平行，避免了主次错位。
tips: 文化议题常见“精神层+治理层”双并列。
value resources for governance 是政策语体常见组合。

front_content.text:
原句：文物数字化既提高了保护效率，也扩大了公共文化服务的可及性。

任务：先汉译英，再选出并列结构最规范的一项。

back_content.text: The digitalization of cultural relics has both improved conservation efficiency and expanded the accessibility of public cultural services.
back_content.explanation: both ... and ... 适配“既……也……”并列结果表达。

analysis_content.text:
① 识别信号：中文“既……也……”要求并列平行。

② 核心规律：完成时语境下，both + 过去分词A + and + 过去分词B 保持结构与时态统一。

③ 验证与纠偏：A 结构最平衡；其余项存在时态混用或并列不平行。
tips: both ... and ... 两端保持词性平行。
accessibility of public services 是高频书面表达。

options.text: The digitalization of cultural relics has both improved conservation efficiency and expanded the accessibility of public cultural services.
The digitalization of cultural relics both improved conservation efficiency and has expanded the accessibility of public cultural services.
The digitalization of cultural relics has improved conservation efficiency, and expanding the accessibility of public cultural services.
The digitalization of cultural relics has both improved conservation efficiency and expand the accessibility of public cultural services.

front_content.text:
原句：公共文化平台持续完善，既丰富了群众精神生活，也提升了文化服务均等化水平。

先做汉译英，再补全骨架：
Public cultural platforms have been continuously improved, {{blank}} enriching people's spiritual life {{blank}} raising the level of equalized cultural services.

back_content.text: Public cultural platforms have been continuously improved, not only enriching people's spiritual life but also raising the level of equalized cultural services.
back_content.explanation: 主句后并列结果可用 not only doing ... but also doing ... 进行压缩表达。

analysis_content.text:
① 识别信号：后段为双结果并列。

② 核心规律：not only doing ... but also doing ... 可在保持并列关系的同时提升句子紧凑度。

③ 验证与纠偏：两空对应 not only 与 but also，代回后并列与逻辑均成立。
tips: 并列 doing 结构需词性与语义对称。
equalized cultural services 对应“文化服务均等化”。

front_content.text:
原句：国际文化交流增进了相互理解，也拓展了文明对话的深度与广度。

任务：先汉译英，再选出最自然的并列译文。

back_content.text: International cultural exchanges have enhanced mutual understanding and broadened both the depth and breadth of civilizational dialogue.
back_content.explanation: enhanced ... and broadened ... 并列对应双结果；both the depth and breadth 强化并列维度。

analysis_content.text:
① 识别信号：中文“也拓展了”是并列第二结果。

② 核心规律：并列表达宜保持谓语平行，并在名词层面再用 both ... and ... 承接“深度与广度”。

③ 验证与纠偏：A 同时实现谓语并列与名词并列，信息完整度最高。
tips: 并列句可出现“谓语并列 + 名词并列”双层结构。
civilizational dialogue 是“文明对话”的稳妥书面表达。

options.text: International cultural exchanges have enhanced mutual understanding and broadened both the depth and breadth of civilizational dialogue.
International cultural exchanges enhanced mutual understanding and have broadened both the depth and breadth of civilizational dialogue.
International cultural exchanges have enhanced mutual understanding, and broadening both the depth and breadth of civilizational dialogue.
International cultural exchanges have enhanced mutual understanding and broaden both the depth and breadth of civilizational dialogue.
